subtitle: Carlos Diaz, a janitor
passage: An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head.
I ran after him, but I couldn’t catch him.
In fact, the old man was not old.
He was a young man with long brown hair.
passage_ko: (관리인 Carlos Diaz) 회색 머리의 한 노인이 달아나고 있었는데, 그의 머리에서 무언가가 떨어졌어요.
저는 그를 뒤쫓아 갔지만, 그를 잡을 수 없었어요.
그는 긴 갈색 머리의 젊은 남자였어요.
